p = 23
# compute quadratic residues mod p (excluding 0)
qr = set()
for i in range(1, (p-1)//2 + 1):
    qr.add((i*i) % p)
print("QR:", sorted(qr))
print("len:", len(qr))

# construct Legendre sequence with x[0] = 1
x = [1 if (i == 0 or i in qr) else -1 for i in range(p)]
print("x:", x)
print("sum:", sum(x))

# compute periodic autocorrelation for k=1..p-1
auto = []
for k in range(1, p):
    s = sum(x[i] * x[(i+k)%p] for i in range(p))
    auto.append(s)
print("autocorrelations k=1..22:", auto)
print("unique:", set(auto))

# check condition for x=y
for k in range(1, (p-1)//2 + 1):
    total = auto[k-1] + auto[k-1]
    print(k, total)
